sources.blocksChecked: weapon_m4a1_silencer_prefab@行4899; 60@行10261; weapon_m4a1_silencer@行14154 —— 以上字段在 3 个条目中完全一致

notes: perBullet 为空（待实测）：没有合法来源的逐发弹道。
recoilParams / accuracyParams 为引擎内部原始参数，[主模式, 副模式]，不是角度，不能直接当作弹道或散布角使用。
单位约定：perBullet 用视角角度（度），x=+右，y=+上。
measurementProcedure: Offline local server only (Practice / 'map de_dust2' with bots off), never on official/community servers.

Console: sv_cheats 1; bot_kick; sv_infinite_ammo 1; weapon_accuracy_nospread 1 (removes random spread, leaves deterministic recoil); sv_showimpacts 1; sv_showimpacts_time 10; cl_showpos 1; host_timescale 0.1 (optional, for readable capture). All these convars exist in DumpSource2/convars.txt of the same snapshot.

Stand still, aim at a flat wall at a known distance, fire one full 30-round magazine WITHOUT touching the mouse (fire via keyboard bind so no hand input contaminates the result). Record with high-fps lossless capture.

Extract the 30 impact markers (sv_showimpacts boxes) from the screenshot/frames; convert screen px -> degrees with CS2 FOV model (fov 90 horizontal at 4:3, Hor+ ~106.26 deg at 16:9): deg = atan(px_offset / (0.5*screenWidth / tan(hfov/2))) in each axis.
Repeat >=5 magazines, average per bullet, verify std-dev small (pattern is deterministic once nospread=1), and check envelope against validationTargets (~11.06 deg high, ~7.14 deg wide).
Record the game build number with the dataset; re-measure after any patch that mentions recoil.
